## Checklist
- [ ] Focused diff; unrelated work preserved.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or unauthorized third-party content.
- [ ] No weakened quality gates or fabricated results.
- [ ] Material AI assistance disclosed; human review completed or requested.
- [ ] Independent review requested for high-risk changes.
- [ ] Structural changes justified by cohesion, coupling, contracts or demonstrated risk; no arbitrary metric-driven fragmentation.
